description:
Calculates the credit cost of create_clip_job or recut_clip_job without spending anything, and checks that MnogoReels can download the video. Free and read-only.

Price: 1 credit per started minute of the processed range (end_sec minus start_sec), minimum 1. Options such as caption style, hooks, B-roll or music do not change the price. One job processes at most 30 minutes; for longer videos quote several ranges with start_sec and end_sec. Without start_sec and end_sec the whole video is priced, so its length must be known; this tool looks it up.

Pass source_url to price a new video, or job_id to price a recut of an existing clip job. A recut without start_sec and end_sec reuses the original job's range, which the API does not reveal; the quote is then an upper bound (the whole source video) and credits_exact is false. Show the credits to the user and get their agreement before calling create_clip_job or recut_clip_job with max_credits of at least this amount.

Returns credits, credits_exact, billed_seconds, the resolved start_sec and end_sec, the platform, whether the video can be downloaded, the source title and length, and a note about failed jobs. If the length cannot be determined (typical for direct file links), the error explains how to pass end_sec yourself.

end_sec.description: End of the part to process, in seconds. Default: the end of the video (its length is looked up automatically when the platform reports it). At most 30 minutes after start_sec.

job_id.description: Existing clip job to price a recut for. Give either source_url or job_id.

source_url.description: Public link to the video: YouTube, VK Video, RuTube, Dzen, Twitch, Yandex Disk file, Google Drive file, or a direct .mp4/.mov/.mkv/.webm link. Local files are not supported.

start_sec.description: Start of the part to process, in seconds from the beginning. Default 0.

name: quote_clip_job

billed_seconds.description: Length of the billed range; null when a recut reuses the original range.

credits.description: Credits that create_clip_job or recut_clip_job will charge for this range (an upper bound when credits_exact is false).

credits_exact.description: False only for a recut that reuses the original range: the charge is at most credits.

downloadable.description: null when the check could not run right now (the range was given, so the price is still exact).

job_id.description: The clip job this recut quote is for; null for a new video.

note.description: Jobs cannot be cancelled. If processing fails, credits are not returned automatically; retry_clip_job re-runs a failed job for free, or contact support@mnogo-reels.ru with the job_id.

pricing_rule.description: 1 credit per started minute of the range, minimum 1; at most 30 minutes per job.

start_sec.description: null = the original job's range is reused (recut).

title: Quote clip job cost
